newsitem.title: UK: Standard rise on Westpac link.
newsitem.headline: Standard rise on Westpac link.

text.p: Shares in Standard Chartered Plc rose on Wednesday after the Anglo-Asian banking group said it had formed a strategic relationship with Westpac Banking Corporation, dealers said.
The shares gained 12-1/2p to 688p by 1103 GMT.
Standard Chartered and Westpac said that the main purpose of the relationship was to provide select Asian banking services to Westpac's medium-to-large customers.
"This is a very good move indeed," said one analyst. "The potential for revenue growth is strong but hard to quantify at the moment."
Added another: "This is a low risk way of achieving higher volumes."
Some analysts said today's rise was partly attributable to recent weakness in Standard Chartered's share price. The shares were trading at a three-month low of 643 on October 23.
